verdict.rationale: Gumloop's own agents work over the user's connected tools and data. They produce reports, spreadsheets and HTML dashboards that can be viewed directly in the chat, so AI-generated output from user data is delivered inside the product. However, no evidence describes a dedicated insights or suggestions capability; the evidence only implies that agents can be prompted to analyze data. Missing for 10: an explicit documented feature for AI insights/suggestions over user data, examples of data analysis or recommendation output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Build AI agents that use your tools and data to do real work
Reports, spreadsheets, images, code files, HTML dashboards: anything your agent creates can be viewed, downloaded, shared, and version-tracked directly from the chat.
Open the Connectors section and add the integrations the agent needs (Gmail, Salesforce, Slack, and so on).
